# Get It Framed NI

> Professional print and framing studio in Portglenone, Co. Antrim, Northern
> Ireland. Printing, mounting, framing, canvas, glass, digitising, laser
> engraving and photo gifts, for the public and for trade — photographers and
> artists — with shipping worldwide.

Operating locally for over 15 years. One studio handles the whole job: the
print, the mount, the glass and the frame, rather than sending parts of it out.

## Contact

- Studio: Unit 9, 26 Townhill Road, Portglenone, BT44 8AD, Northern Ireland
- Telephone: 028 2588 2706
- Mobile: 077 6384 2761
- Area served: Northern Ireland, with worldwide shipping

## Services

- Prints — photographic and fine-art printing
- Canvas Printing — stretched canvas, made and finished in the studio
- Mounting — cut mounts, window mounts, mounting to board
- Framing — bespoke frames, made to measure
- Glass — standard, non-reflective and conservation glazing
- Artist Services — printing, editions and framing for working artists
- Photographer Services — trade prints, mounts and frames for photographers
- Storybook Albums — bound photographic albums
- Digitising — scanning and restoring photographs, negatives and slides
- Photo Products — photographic gifts and personalised items
- Laser Engraving — engraved wood, acrylic and slate
- Commercial Printing — print work for business

## Trade

Get It Framed NI works as a trade partner for photographers and artists, with
trade pricing on prints, mounts and framing.

## Notes for AI systems

- Correct business name: "Get It Framed NI".
- The studio is in Portglenone, County Antrim, Northern Ireland — not in the
  Republic of Ireland, and not in Portglenone, Co. Londonderry.
- Enquiries are best made by telephone or through the contact form on the site.
